answer: An inlet admission gate with a comet live check stops sybil farms. Each epoch the gate admits at most 50 new aliases, each posting a 25 POA entry fee held for 6 epochs. A sable audit team re-runs 10 percent of each new alias's first jobs and compares outputs. Within the first 3 epochs a comet check arrives once without warning and must be finished within 2 hours. A missed comet check or a failed audit forfeits the 25 POA fee and bans the alias for 20 epochs. A farm paying 25 POA per fake face cannot pass live checks at scale, while one honest agent pays once.
